requirements.summary: Revert all frontend files to their Version 38 state, removing all Version 39 changes
acceptanceCriteria: All frontend files reflect the Version 38 state, not Version 39.
None of the changes introduced in Version 39 are present in the deployed application.
The application builds and deploys successfully from the Version 38 codebase.

file_operations.description: Revert to Version 38 implementation of the root component, removing any Version 39 authentication flow, profile setup logic, or rendering changes.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the add holding dialog, restoring original form fields, validation logic, and submission behavior.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the add staking reward dialog, restoring original form structure and submission handling.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the edit holding dialog, restoring original edit functionality and form validation.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the edit staking reward dialog, restoring original edit workflow.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the footer component, restoring original content and styling.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the header component, restoring original authentication UI, theme toggle, and user display logic.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the holdings manager, restoring original table structure, actions, and dialog integrations.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the increment holding dialog, restoring original increment logic and calculations.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the individual crypto performance component, restoring original chart rendering and metrics display.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the login prompt, restoring original landing page content and feature cards.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the portfolio chart, restoring original data generation and chart configuration.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the portfolio composition chart, restoring original pie chart calculation and rendering.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the portfolio overview, restoring original metrics summary and asset card display logic.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the portfolio performance chart, restoring original area chart and time range handling.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the profile setup modal, restoring original form and submission behavior.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the staking rewards manager, restoring original table structure and CRUD operations.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the actor hook, restoring original actor creation, caching, and query invalidation logic.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the crypto prices hook, restoring original API integration, symbol mappings, and price fetching logic.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the Internet Identity hook, restoring original authentication context and provider logic.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the React Query hooks, restoring original query and mutation definitions for all backend operations.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of the dashboard page, restoring original layout and component composition.
Revert to Version 38 implementation of URL parameter utilities, restoring original query string and hash-based routing helpers.
Revert to Version 38 global stylesheet, restoring original Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties, theme definitions, and keyframe animations.
Revert to Version 38 application entry point, restoring original provider setup and React app mounting.
Revert to Version 38 Tailwind configuration, restoring original theme tokens, color definitions, and plugin configuration.
Revert to Version 38 HTML entry point, restoring original meta tags, title, and script loading.
Revert to Version 38 root CSS file, restoring original OKLCH-based theme variables and global styles.
